tiles.name: Concurrent viewers — exact peak vs time-weighted average

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(bucket_start) AS ts, max(bucket_peak) AS peak, round(sum(active_ms) / ($__interval_s * 1000.0), 2) AS time_weighted_average FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_total WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(bucket_start) AS ts, title, round(sum(active_ms) / ($__interval_s * 1000.0), 2) AS avg_concurrent FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_content WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND $__filters AND content_id IN (SELECT content_id FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_content WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND $__filters GROUP BY content_id ORDER BY sum(active_ms) DESC LIMIT 8) GROUP BY ts, title ORDER BY ts

SELECT title, video_type, category, max(bucket_peak) AS exact_peak, argMax(ending_concurrency, bucket_start) AS now, round(sum(active_ms) / 3600000.0, 2) AS viewer_hours FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_content WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND $__filters GROUP BY title, video_type, category ORDER BY max(bucket_peak) DESC LIMIT 25

config.markdown:
### Live layer — 10-second grain, best-effort

Reads `serving_concurrency_live`, rebuilt every 10 seconds over a trailing window by `sonyliv-ingest concurrency --layer live --loop 10s`. It keeps **three days** at 10-second grain and nothing older, so selecting a window before that is expected to read zero rather than being a fault — the history lives on *SonyLIV — Concurrency analytics*. It publishes **without waiting for late events**, so a late arrival can change an already-published bucket. That is the trade a "right now" number makes. The corrected answer is on *SonyLIV — Concurrency analytics*.

**A viewer is concurrent when** the session has started, has not ended, is in the foreground, is playing, and has produced a liveness signal within the last 120s. Foreground and playing are independent — measured on the extract, 13,382 of 14,256 `AppForegrounded` events leave playback stopped, so treating them as one state overcounts. Policy `sonyliv-active-v1`; intervals are half-open `[start, end)` in UTC.

**Why the peak tile ignores the Title filter.** Peaks are not additive: two titles peak at different instants, so summing per-title peaks invents viewers who were never simultaneously present. An exact peak has to be computed *at* the grouping it is reported for, so it is precomputed per grouping — the headline tile reads the all-titles rows, and exact per-title peaks are in the leaderboard. Every other tile responds to the filters, because `active_ms` and `ending_concurrency` **are** additive and stay exact under any filter combination.
